tools.name: headcount_plan
tools.description: Estimate how many invited guests will attend (adults vs children) and the food, drink, cake, favor and plate quantities to buy, with standard buffers. Use when sizing the shopping list from an invite count. Do NOT use for spending (use party_budget) or a dated to-do plan (use party_timeline).

tools.name: party_timeline
tools.description: Build a dated countdown plan for a party, with task lists at 6 weeks, 4, 3, 2 and 1 week, 3 days, the day before and the day itself. Use when the date is set and the host needs to know what to do when. Do NOT use for spending (use party_budget) or a categorized supplies list (use party_checklist).
